baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a washing machine motor speed sensor (part number 290D1187P006). A washing machine motor speed sensor that creates an electromagnetic field to detect motor speed and send electrical signals to the washing machine control unit. It is comprised of a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with a Hall Effect sensor enclosed within a plastic housing, and a wire harness with a specialized electrical connector at the end. The washing machine motor speed sensor (part number 290D1187P006) is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from China and Thailand.

The Printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with Hall Effect sensor, Wire harness and Specialized electrical connector are produced in China. The Plastic housing are produced in Thailand. 

Final assembly in Thailand: Attach wire harness to PCBA; Enclose PCBA and wire harness within plastic housing; Attach electrical connector to the end of the wire harness; Test finished device; Package finished device for shipment.

key_factors: Printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with Hall Effect sensor
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the Hall Effect sensor and PCBA in China
prediction.reasoning: Per N343953 and N344809, the essential character of a Hall Effect speed sensor is imparted by the Hall Effect sensor IC/PCBA, which performs the core sensing and transduction function. Here, the PCBA with the Hall Effect sensor, wire harness, and connector are all produced in China. The operations in Thailand (attaching the wire harness and connector, enclosing in a Thai plastic housing, and testing) constitute simple assembly and do not substantially transform the Chinese PCBA.

key_factors: Printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with Hall Effect sensor
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacture of the PCBA with Hall Effect sensor and final assembly in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP rulings N344808 and N344809, the essential character of a Hall Effect speed sensor is imparted by the active sensing element—here, the PCBA with the Hall Effect sensor. Because the PCBA with the Hall Effect sensor is manufactured in Thailand, and the Chinese-origin wire harness and connector are merely subordinate components attached during final assembly in Thailand, the country of origin of the finished motor speed sensor is Thailand.

verdict.reasoning: In paired rulings N343953 and N344809 on Hall Effect speed sensors, CBP held that the Hall Effect sensor IC and PCBA impart the essential character of the finished sensor. When the Hall Effect IC was made in China and assembled with a PCB and plastic housing in Thailand (N343953), origin was China. When production of the Hall Effect IC and PCBA moved to Thailand with only ancillary components from China (N344809), origin changed to Thailand. Here, moving the manufacture of the PCBA with the Hall Effect sensor from China to Thailand likewise changes the country of origin to Thailand.
